metadata.description: Core/Content/Utility sequential implementation for terrain v20, world-map control hardening, protobuf reference verification, shared DLL architecture, and dummy protocol probes.

features.name: Shared hydrology signature contract v20
features.description: Shared signature updated to v20 and consumed by server/client map-control signature builders.

features.name: Server-authoritative profile version 24
features.description: World generation and runtime map-control profile targets bumped to v24.

features.name: Unity world config parity v24
features.description: Unity world config defaults and StreamingAssets world config aligned to profile version 24.

features.name: Catchment-braiding river bridge
features.description: River generation gains catchment-braiding bridge pass to reduce seam fragmentation.

features.name: Lake catchment spillway stitch
features.description: Lake generation adds spillway stitch pass for river-connected continuity.

features.name: Cave hydrology seam vault
features.description: Cave generation adds hydrology seam vault sealing for aquifer/riparian stability.

features.name: Server chunk inflight dedup cache
features.description: WorldMapControlManager now deduplicates inflight chunk generation tasks and clears them on profile reload/signature drift.

features.name: Client queue/building budget hardening
features.description: Unity map preview controller tracks queued/building chunks to avoid duplicate builds and enforces queue budget deterministically.

features.name: Proto probe profile diagnostics
features.description: Dummy protocol client now warns on invalid world-map profile versions in addition to signature drift.

features.name: Session-57 manifest bootstrap
features.description: Server startup now prioritizes session-57 feature manifest loading for sequential implementation visibility.
